The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.
Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.
I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.
